sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 43; Internal Quality Checks row 43 'Gate/constraint failures hard-zero the quality terms, and passing only the cheap gates earns little.')
evidence: Gates: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-3 render=0.0, constraints=0.0; weights functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (lines 5-8), floor functional=0.05 (line 11). scoring.toml, tools/score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean). score.py:40-48 reads gate dims only for gates_passed (score>0.0), never adds them to the weighted sum (sum over [weights] only), sets scored dims to 0 unless gates passed, and returns reward 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed; returns exit 1 on gate failure. test.sh:212-226 deletes any stale scored dir, runs gates suite (timeout/failure -> exit 0 with the pre-written zero record, lines 8,14-18,60-61), exit 1 from score.py stops before the scored suite, any other error writes the plain zero. Gate judge.toml files are all_pass binary single criteria with no [judge] weight key. Measured: ran the frozen score.py (Python 3.12) on synthetic records in scratchpad: render=0 -> reward 0.0000, exit 1, gates_passed 0, scored values ignored even when supplied as 1.0; constraints=0 -> 0.0000 exit 1; gates pass but no scored record -> 0.0000; functional=0.0476 (one passed 2.0-weight criterion of 42) with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0000 (weighted 0.4286 withheld by floor); functional=0.0357 (one 1.5 criterion) -> 0.0000; missing gate key -> exit 2 (test.sh writes plain zero); full -> 1.0. Weak-app reasoning: a polished static shell or blank page fails the render/constraints gates (persistence + cross-user visibility required) -> 0. An app passing both gates but no functional criterion -> floor fails -> 0 regardless of polish/visual, satisfying the internal note that passing only the cheap gates earns little. Clearing the 0.05 floor needs >=2.1/42 functional weight, i.e. two 1.5 criteria or one >=2.5 criterion, each of which carries positive controls requiring a substantially working chat (replies with quotes + safe formatting, or idempotent ordered posting with search and transcript), so a non-working app cannot farm polish/visual. Conforming alternative: gate criteria allow external CDN assets and do not grade roles/correctness, so a valid app is not wrongly gated. Residual (why risk=true): no full configured verifier run on these bytes demonstrates the end-to-end gate-fail skip or the floor on a mutated weak app; raw-evidence-index.json scope states a full grading run and reward discrimination/ranking records are absent. Also note an app passing one 2.5-3.0 functional criterion can collect up to ~0.44 from polish/visual; that is a weighting/ranking matter for rows 42/44 under template-fixed floor policy, not a defect of this row.
